role: 中年女，四十岁左右，爽朗干练
label: middle-aged woman, about 40, bright and brisk
description: 一位四十岁左右的中年女性，在城市里经营一家小店，性格爽朗干练，说话干脆利落、语速稍快，嗓音明亮清脆，音色干净。
ref_text: 行了行了，这事交给我。明天一早我先去把合同签了，下午再带人把货清点一遍，保证误不了你们的事。
listening_notes: 2026-09-28: redesigned (experiments/m6_mid_woman_brisk.json). The first version, an inn landlady with a thick voice, sounded older than forty and much like 刘兰芳, the 评书 performer. This one: s2 best, s0 and s1 sounded like a man; the 20-clip check sounds consistent
